title: Reduce nested series and parallel resistor networks
prompt: Implement solve(payload) where payload["network"] is a recursive tree. A leaf is {"kind":"resistor","ohms":R}; a branch is {"kind":"series"|"parallel","children":[nodes...]}. Nonnegative resistance is measured in ohms. Series resistance is the sum; parallel resistance is 1/sum(1/R), except any zero-ohm child shorts the parallel branch to zero. Return {"ohms":equivalent}. Validate the entire tree, even branches hidden by a short: negative resistances, unknown kinds, or empty children return {"error":"invalid_network"}. Nodes otherwise have the appropriate keys/types; trees have depth at most 20 and at most 100 nodes. Any numeric inputs are finite; inputs have the documented shapes; unspecified validation is out of scope. Do not mutate payload or any nested value. Numeric absolute tolerance 1e-9, relative tolerance 1e-9; strings, booleans, errors and collection shapes must match exactly.
